notes: Nine-storey 2001 live/work block: exposed concrete frame (columns + slab edges), bays alternating light-blue sliding screen panels, recessed balconies with glass guards and full-height glazing; ground: glazed bays under a pale grey band, concrete walls with steel garage doors and a glazed lobby in the recessed courts. Frosted translucent screen leaves (glass-frosted) covering most of each screen bay, neutral grey concrete frame and recess reveals, no balcony planters, frosted ground-floor glazing. Tints re-derived cool, blue-grey louvred screen leaves standing proud of the frame, dark reflective ground-floor/lobby glazing. Recess/balcony walls a darker grey of the same hue; screen leaves blue-grey (not lilac, not saturated); street glazing frosted white; roll-up garage doors light grey steel (a metal finish read brown in the recess); now clear glass over room-tone backing with blinds (kit glassBacking, kind grid). They take a warmer returnWallTint. Opaque metal-tinted pane over a dark room, no room-tone backing; darker street glass). Screen leaves are opaque pale blue-grey painted slats (painted-white tint, 9 blades a leaf) at seeded slide positions per bay (panelCoverageRange); the frame projects further and the glass, balconies and screens sit deeper behind it; dark steel-and-glass balcony guards and planters. Now bays ~2.7 m (square cells), two full-height louvre leaves per screen bay standing at the frame face (kit panelSlide leaf / panelOutM), one or both closed per bay, pale steel-blue frosted-glass louvres (glass-louvre, slats drawn in the material); open bays recessed with a dark solid steel guard; the two court faces are glazed white-framed loggias with balcony decks out to the frame line, dark glass guards and planters (kit kind loggia); ground: white-framed pale blue-grey milky shop glass under a pale band, dark lobby glass in the court, dark grey corrugated garage gates, round wall lamps. Leaves tinted steel-blue, upper glass glass-sky, loggia guards dark film, shop glass darker blue-grey. LiDAR (3DEP 2023) shows the rear strip along the rear street is a four-storey wing at ~12 m; the SW end is full height. LowParts steps it. The NE-end ground floor was shop glass; the frame read dark slate with black voids in 7 stations; light grey/white concrete, glass balcony guards, blue glass and a glazed lobby with a canopy. Frame, walls and ground band now painted light cool grey (painted-white, the precast albedo could not reach it), lighter soffits, glass guards, brighter blue recess glass, reflective shop glass in place of frosted blank panels, a glass canopy over the court lobby, slatted silver roll-up shutters (glass-shutter) and a gridded gate at the NE garages, less soot. No balconies/glass guards read, flat mullions, flat entry canopy, garages flat painted doors. Open balcony bays now have deck slabs projecting ~1 m past the wall line (as far as the footprint allowance permits per bay) with the glass guard at the lip; 16 cm deep mullions; an opaque pale glass canopy over the lobby; the NE garage shutters set 1.4 m back in dark mouths under a slatted screen. Leaf tint paler/greyer; a blank dark plaque over the court lobby where the building number hangs (no digits). NE ground columns aligned to the garage piers (explicit column positions on that face). A faint grime pass (weathering.grime 0.07). Ground band a step darker concrete. NE garage face frame tint mid concrete grey so the recessed bays read shadowed. Deeper balcony lip 1.2 (footprint-capped) and 24 cm mullions. NE-face left glazed garage replaced by a tan slatted gate. NE balcony rails perforated dark mesh. More open glass (closed leaves 30%), deeper glass recess 1.6, darker balcony slabs and frame, saturated blue-sky upper glass, muted grey-green shop glass, warm lit lobby glass on the court-9 face. Left garage back to the light gridded glazed-garage gate. NE face frame darker for deeper-reading bays. Frame/wall/ground band/balcony tints one step darker (concrete mid grey), plinth 0.55 m, shop pane 0.9 m; glass tones unchanged. Street-level shop/lobby glass back to dark opaque reflective (no lit beige interiors through it).

lowParts.source: USGS 3DEP Lidar Point Cloud CA_SanFrancisco_B23 tile 05200270 (2023 survey, public domain): returns inside the DataSF footprint gridded at 1 m above the median ground return beside it; the rear 12.9 m strip along the rear edge reads 12.07 m (median of 96-cell rows, whole length), the rest 26.6 m. Step between spec-frame z -13 and -12.
